greet_la.text: hey you. welcome to Mini-LA — I shrunk my hometown so you'd finally visit.
see those sparkles? each one is something I remember. go poke them. I'll come with you.
(and keep an eye out for figs. you'll know why.)

chat.text: the sparkles are memories. the figs are figs. the cat is a menace.
there's a road east of here. it leads somewhere that smells like Greece.
I hid figs in the tall grass. Mookie may or may not have moved some.
